topic:gmc-registration:prioritisation_ac.verified_value: The Medical Training (Prioritisation) Act 2026 (2026 c. 7) defines a "UK medical graduate" as a person who holds a primary United Kingdom qualification within the meaning of the Medical Act 1983, but not a person who spent all or a majority of their time training for that qualification outside the British Islands
topic:gmc-registration:prioritisation_ac.quote: 4 (1) In this Act, "UK medical graduate" means a person who holds a primary United Kingdom qualification within the meaning of the Medical Act 1983 (see section 4(3) of that Act), but does not include a person who spent all or a majority of their time training for that qualification outside the British Islands. [5th March 2026; S. 1 in force at 6.3.2026 by S.I. 2026/221]

topic:gmc-registration:foundation_eligib.verified_value: Final-year students at UK medical schools are nominated by their medical school to apply for the 2027 Foundation Programme if they are expected to qualify by 3 August 2027. Applicants studying at or qualified from a non-UK medical school, or a UK medical school campus outside the UK, apply through the Eligibility application process first
topic:gmc-registration:foundation_eligib.quote: UK final year students will be nominated by their medical school to apply for the 2027 Foundation Programme if they are expected to qualify by 03 August 2027. … Applicants are required to apply via the Eligibility application process … if … The applicant is studying at or has qualified from a non-UK medical school; OR … has qualified from a UK medical school on or prior to 03 August 2025 OR … a UK medical school campus outside of the UK [right-to-work and visa sponsorship are not stated on this page; removed]
